shipped_rows.title_o: Effects of an Automated Vocabulary and Comprehension Intervention
shipped_rows.authors_o: Spencer; Goldstein; Sherman; Noe; Tabbah; Ziolkowski; Schneider

blind_target.evidence_quote: In 2013, Spencer, Goldstein, Sherman, et al. reported the promising effects of a supplemental, technology-assisted, storybook intervention (Tier 2) containing embedded instruction targeting the oral language learning of preschool children at risk for delays. We sought to advance knowledge of the intervention by replicating it in a new sample and examining children’s responses to the narrator’s instructional prompts and associations with learning outcomes.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Exposure to the intervention accelerated children’s weekly oral language learning, and effect sizes were comparable to those of Spencer et al.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Abstract explicitly compares the intervention effects to Spencer et al. and reports comparable effects.
